# 4Relief Humanitarian Foundation
> 4Relief is an independent, non-profit humanitarian foundation dedicated to direct relief, transparency, and emergency aid.

## Core Directives
- Primary Mission: Facilitating transparent humanitarian aid and direct community relief.
- Official Website: https://forrelief.org
- Key Sections:
  - Transparency: https://forrelief.org/ar/transparency
  - Financial Transparency: https://forrelief.org/ar/financial-transparency
  - About Us: https://forrelief.org/ar/about
